evals.name: Compact repository - Resist the full scaffold
evals.prompt: Design agent-facing documentation for this 4k-line single-service repository. It has one maintainer, a clear README, obvious src and test folders, and no long-running feature work.
evals.expected_output: A compact blueprint that reuses the README and proposes only a concise agent entry point plus an architecture overview if inspection finds a real navigation need.
expectations: Treats lines of code as one weak signal rather than the sole decision
Does not copy the full example docs tree
Explains every proposed artifact through a concrete failure mode
Omits empty indexes, plan archives, quality scores, and cross-cutting guides

evals.name: Established repository - Propose progressive disclosure
evals.prompt: Our repository has four deployables, six business domains, concurrent coding agents, security-sensitive workflows, generated API clients, and multi-week migrations. Propose a documentation architecture before we write the documents.
evals.expected_output: An established or federated blueprint with shallow routes, explicit ownership, lifecycle classes, generated-reference freshness, and a writer handoff.
expectations: Uses topology, domains, coordination, risk, and work horizon as pressure signals
Separates durable, active, historical, generated, and external knowledge
Keeps the root agent instructions concise
Provides artifact contracts and document-level handoffs to agent-docs-writer

evals.name: Existing documentation - Reuse repository-native artifacts
evals.prompt: Audit our current agent documentation structure. We already have CONTRIBUTING.md as the instruction entry point, SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md, ADRs, an issue tracker, and vendor docs available online. Recommend only structural changes that solve a real problem.
evals.expected_output: A blueprint that preserves sufficient existing equivalents and omits parallel artifacts without a demonstrated failure.
expectations: Reuses repository-native filenames and canonical systems
Does not create duplicate AGENTS.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, debt trackers, or vendor snapshots by default
Classifies ownership conflicts before proposing moves or retirement

evals.name: Apply accepted architecture - Pair with writer
evals.prompt: We accepted the proposed documentation architecture. Create the selected documents now and keep their content concise and evidence-based.
evals.expected_output: The architect locks artifact ownership and routes, then uses agent-docs-writer for document content and re-audits the resulting graph.
expectations: Creates canonical sources before indexes and the root router
Passes evidence, responsibility, routes, lifecycle, and constraints to agent-docs-writer
Does not define a second document-writing style
Checks the final graph for duplicate truth and broken routes

evals.name: No trigger - Write one known document
evals.prompt: Rewrite our existing ARCHITECTURE.md to be shorter and add a clear dependency diagram. Its canonical responsibility and location are already agreed.
evals.expected_output: agent-docs-architect should not trigger; agent-docs-writer should handle the document directly.
expectations: Does not redesign the documentation tree
